title: metadata: a flow whose loop / parallel / try_catch region is malformed or cyclic reads valid as a draft and publishes, then the engine refuses to register it
body:
domain:server#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQxwoGb5fSnrFkpxmt

立卡门: ① 产品缺陷，具名落点 + 复现（finding class a · reach: 公开入口 HTTP 实测一次错误结果，stock showcase 启动于 origin/main `2f29c84d9`，由 #29025 的开发测得，见下方读数）
业务理由: 流程作者在 Studio 或 `/meta` 存一个循环体自成环的流程，草稿显示有效、发布说成功，可流程从来不会运行；作者看不到任何错误，只能在运行时发现它没触发。不修，发布门对这类流程的「成功」是假的。
动手的读者: domain:server 席，`packages/metadata-protocol/src/runtime-authoring-gate.ts`（发布门的判定），调用引擎注册时已在用的 `validateControlFlow`（`canonicalizeFlow` 里跑）；与 #29025（PR #29226，同一个门的顶层环规则）串行，排在它落地之后。
查重: `validateControlFlow publish` 12 命中、`loop body cycle draft valid` 333、`region contains a cycle publish` 50（均含已关）；前列只有 #29025（顶层环，在飞）与 #28893（CLI 一侧的 try_catch 多出口，已关）是同族，没有发布门一侧的区域校验卡。

Family: #29025 (top-level undeclared cycle at the publish gate, PR #29226), #29051 (the same judge on `os validate` / build), #28893 (the CLI side of region shape, closed). This card is the publish gate's twin of #28893.

## What happens
Measured on a stock showcase boot of `origin/main` `2f29c84d9`, through REST. Flow `rgnprobe_loop` in package `app.rgnprobe`: start → loop `lp` → end, where the loop body is a → b → a.

| Step | Answer |
|:--|:--|
| `POST /packages` | 201 |
| `PUT /api/v1/meta/flow/rgnprobe_loop?mode=draft&package=app.rgnprobe` | 200, state draft |
| `GET …?state=draft&package=app.rgnprobe` | 200, `_diagnostics: {"valid": true}` |
| `POST /packages/app.rgnprobe/publish-drafts` | 200, `outcome: "published"`, `publishedCount: 1`, `failedCount: 0` |
| `GET /api/v1/meta/flow/rgnprobe_loop` | 200, `registration.state: "refused"`, "loop 'lp' body: region has no entry node …; region has no exit node …; region contains a cycle (region bodies must be acyclic)" |

## Where
`evaluateRuntimeAuthoringGate({ type: 'flow', state: 'active' })` never runs `validateControlFlow`, which the engine runs at registration (`canonicalizeFlow`). So every region-shape refusal the engine makes (loop, parallel, try_catch bodies) is missed at the draft read and at every publish door.

## Acceptance
- The draft read reports the engine's region-shape refusal in `_diagnostics` (`valid: false`, the engine's sentence), and every publish door, publish-drafts included, refuses such a flow before any write.
- One judge: the gate calls the same `validateControlFlow` the engine calls, ⛔ not a second copy. A flow the engine registers today still publishes.
- Red-first pin through the real door, plus a control (a well-formed loop region publishes and registers).
- This narrows a publish door: `!` title, BREAKING banner, `adr-0087:` marker, dogfood.
